newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end higher on State Bank speculation.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end higher on State Bank speculation.

text.p: Stocks on the Delhi bourse closed higher on Friday on speculative buying fuelled by rumours that the government may allow financial institutions to raise their holdings in State Bank of India, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 5.20 points higher at 751.55 points.

Brokers said rumours that financial institutions may be allowed to raise their stake in the State Bank of India, India's largest commercial bank, to 24 percent from 20 percent drove the bank's shares up 10.40 rupees to 288.75.
Steel maker TISCO's shares rose 3.10 rupees to 197.70 on steady speculative buying amid rumours that the government was considering cutting the excise duty on steel.
Reliance Industries quoted 2.30 rupees higher at 274.80.
Oriental Bank of Commerce rose 1.30 rupees to 74.00 on buying by investors.
Larsen and Toubro closed 1.10 rupees higher at 246.
ITC rose 4.35 rupees to close at 424.60.
